_comment: Guided tour of the code editor. Steps point at real controls; the one awaited step waits for the user to press New themselves.

steps.title: A scripting workbench inside ChiSurf
steps.text: Edit Python files and notebooks, run them against the live ChiSurf session, lint them with Ruff and ask the assistant. This tour shows the row of controls on the editor tab; you press the buttons, the tour only points at them.

steps.title: Start with an empty document
steps.text: Every document opens in its own tab. New creates an empty Python buffer; Open reads a file from disk, and nothing is written until you save.

await.hint: Press New to open an empty document.

steps.title: The text area
steps.text: Type here. Syntax highlighting, selection, clipboard, undo/redo and Ctrl+F find work as in any editor. Unsaved changes are marked with an asterisk on the tab.

steps.title: Where a script runs
steps.text: Separate process is isolated and can be stopped. In ChiSurf console runs on the main thread with access to the datasets and fits of the running session, but a long macro blocks the window.

steps.title: Run the script
steps.text: Run executes the active Python document with the endpoint chosen on the left and shows its output in the Output tab below.

steps.title: Lint before you run
steps.text: Check reports Ruff diagnostics for the unsaved buffer in the Diagnostics tab; Fix applies Ruff's safe fixes to the buffer, which you then save explicitly. Both need the optional Ruff executable.

steps.title: Keyboard shortcuts and the rest
steps.text: The ? button lists every shortcut (save, find, go to definition, back/forward through jumps).
